name: hello-webapp

dependencies.name: hello-api
dependencies.description: Calls getGreeting to fetch the greeting text it displays.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Signs the user in through the platform's SSO (OAuth PKCE) before the greeting is shown.

description: The single-page React app, the only user-facing surface: it redirects unauthenticated visitors to SSO sign-in, fetches the greeting from hello-api and shows it, with a sign-out control. It stores no data and has no navigation, because the requirements ask for a single page.
